entities.summary: Hedy Madeleine Fry, is a Canadian politician and physician, and is currently Canada's longest-serving female Member of Parliament. A member of the Liberal Party, she has won eleven consecutive elections in the constituency of Vancouver Centre, starting with the 1993 election, when she defeated then incumbent Prime Minister Kim Campbell.
